dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Not bad, customer. I didn't think you'd be able to pick me apart that easily. Impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Hehe. It seems that you have to keep trying. Come again next time!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Customer, you're pretty lucky. Today is definitely going to be a lucky day. Why don't you buy an Uncut Stone when you're done playing?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Customer, I guess your luck isn't in the cards today. Normally, one'd open an Uncut Stone when they lose. How about one?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the actual probability of finding jade?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Well, that's the million Mora question isn't it? But seriously, it would ruin the game if I knew the probability in every case. A game of probability is nowhere near as exciting as a game of chance!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: And hey — even if there's no jade inside, who's to say you won't find something else instead?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: I kid you not, just the other day a big business owner comes in here, opens a stone, and sure, no jade, but there's a good few chunks of ore in there. Not good enough for him of course, he gives them right back to me without a second look. Don't get me wrong, I appreciate the generosity, I've just got nowhere to store them.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: So how about you take them? My investment in your future, shall we say — and if you ever want to return the favor, you know where to find my store... hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: You there, you're looking radiant today. Clearly it must be your lucky day!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: How about it, wanna try your luck betting on jade?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Betting on jade?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Oh? This is your first time at The Jade Mystery?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Here at The Jade Mystery, we pride ourselves in our generations of expertise in crafting jade finery. We have quite a reputation in Liyue, if I do say so myself.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Though the industry hasn't been as booming recently. The Ministry of Civil Affairs has shut down the Chasm, cutting off supplies.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: As such, the raw materials are worth more than the finished goods these days... So I figured, why not sell the uncut rocks off? Betting on them is exciting, and who knows, perhaps I might just make some money.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Now all my old card game buddies come here to bet on jade. Business is better than a few other places around here, that's for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about this jade.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Never played before, huh? That's rare.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: These stones were all dug out of the mines. They're generally of better quality. Pick out one that you like and buy it.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: "He who knows the jade, gets paid."

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Don't worry about picking a dud one, there's another saying in the industry —

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: "If your luck doesn't come today, it's waiting for you tomorrow!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Gotta go.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Leaving just like that? You never know what luck you might be giving up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have anything besides uncut rocks for sale?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Sure, have a look! These were all cut from raw stone. Although these aren't exactly rare jade, maybe you'll find something that strikes your fancy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Alas... I wish him all the best...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: But feelings are feelings. We must keep on living, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Now, I've been thinking — perhaps I should rename that type of Noctilucous Jade used in the Rite of Parting, as a manner of remembering Rex Lapis by.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Which do you think sounds better, "Parting Jade" or "Ascending Jade"? I feel like they're about equal...
